title: Read bounded Project notes with stable audit and offline-history evidence

requirements.invariant: Every note page is bound to one stable AccountID and ProjectID. Project display text and copied Client text never identify the parent Project, widen scope or authorize visibility.

Project notes have stable IDs, nonblank content while visible, immutable creator/creation/source evidence, an explicit revision plus paired edit audit evidence, and an explicit tombstone state that cannot expose live content as deleted evidence.

A bounded note page is ordered newest first by the deterministic pair (createdAt, id), uses a stable continuation boundary, and exposes whether the local result covers complete Project history. Empty or partial local state never silently claims complete history.

requirements.section: Security and Sync Requirements for Later Target Mapping
requirements.invariant: Rows, visible counts and tombstones in the local page are already authorized for the Principal's exact Account and Project. The read value performs no authorization and reveals no hidden row, actor or dependency count; later RLS and Sync must enforce the same scope.

Project-note values and pages are immutable local read evidence with validated identifiers, finite ordered audit times, query identity, LocalDataVersion, ready/partial/stale quality and as-of evidence. Canonical decode reconstructs only through the same validators.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral ProjectNoteQuerying port watches an exact typed ProjectNotePageRequest and returns ProjectNotePage values using domain and standard Swift types only; it contains no generic CRUD, provider listener, authorization implementation or backend SDK type.

This Phase 1 read boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no note mutation, Project table, RLS policy, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ProjectNoteID is a stable offline-allocatable domain identity. ProjectNoteText and ProjectNoteSource reject blank or malformed visible values without using a provider representation.

ProjectNoteSnapshot binds one AccountID, ProjectID, ProjectNoteID, content-or-tombstone state, immutable creator PrincipalID/display snapshot/source/creation time, explicit revision and optional paired last-editor/time evidence. All dates are finite and creation <= edit <= deletion whenever those audit events exist.

ProjectNotePageRequest binds exact Account/Project scope, a bounded page size no greater than 200 and an optional structured (createdAt, id) continuation cursor for the same scope. Its deterministic fingerprint has no provider token.

ProjectNotePage binds the exact request to a shared ListLocalSnapshot, refuses cross-scope/duplicate/unsorted/over-limit rows, and permits complete Project-history truth only when the local snapshot is complete. Any continuation cursor equals the final returned (createdAt, id) boundary.
ProjectNoteQuerying exposes only watchNotes(_:) over typed local pages. ProjectNoteDataFailure provides stable bounded text/source/audit/scope/order/cursor/query/readiness codes.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 provider-free contract creates no project_notes relation, revision/audit/tombstone column, foreign key, constraint, index, view, trigger or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No AddProjectNote, EditProjectNote or RemoveProjectNote handler, authorization check, revision lock, audit assignment, idempotency result or server page/search handler exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Account/Project/value validation and already-authorized local shape are not authorization. No membership predicate, grant, USING/WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local note table, bounded-history download rule, tombstone retention policy, on-demand history stream or provider readiness proof is defined.

items: Note, cursor, request and page values are immutable Codable evidence and reconstruct only through the same identity/text/source/audit/scope/order/cursor/readiness validators.

The shared ListLocalSnapshot retains exact query fingerprint, bounded already-authorized rows/count, completeness, ready/partial/stale quality, LocalDataVersion and canonical as-of time across restart.

Cross-Account/Project rows, duplicate IDs, blank content, malformed source, invalid audit order, unsorted rows, mismatched cursor/fingerprint and false complete-history claims fail atomically without returning a partial page.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project-note values contain no attachment reference, local bytes, image URL, cache, upload, retention or media deletion behavior.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Notes tab, current ProjectContext/service, MCP note tool/schema, indexed search, transport handler, capability catalog or app/MCP parity claim is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase embedded/nested note, missing actor/timestamp variant or source row is decoded, normalized, deduplicated, quarantined or reconciled.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failure codes are contract values only; no telemetry signal, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

This slice cannot authorize or mutate notes, choose edit/delete roles, define physical storage or Sync retention, expose indexed search, import source notes, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic active, edited and tombstoned notes preserve exact Account/Project/note identity, source/creator/creation/edit/deletion audit, revision, newest-first tie-broken order, bounded request and explicit history/readiness evidence.

Representative ready, partial, stale, complete-history, incomplete-history and tombstoned pages round-trip byte-identically with exact structured cursor, query fingerprint, LocalDataVersion and as-of evidence.

Blank content, malformed source, unpaired/reversed/nonfinite audit, cross-scope/duplicate/unsorted/over-limit rows, mismatched cursor/fingerprint and false complete-history evidence fail atomically through stable non-enumerating codes.

A deterministic reference port returns only the exact typed Account/Project/page request, preserves incomplete local history, refuses a mismatched request without yielding rows and yields no false page on failure.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming schema, authorization, Sync, mutation, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 Project-note read foundation only. It defines exact authorized local read values and bounded history truth but no mutation, edit/delete role policy, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP entry point, indexed search, migration, hosted resource, production access or cutover.
